name: aeep
description: Discover and compare capabilities, configure agents, and route approved actions.

interface.shortDescription: Route actions and inspect evidence and receipts.
interface.longDescription: Select compatible implementations under operator limits, execute configured local actions, and inspect receipts. Stack proposals and reviewed assessments keep their own authority requirements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AEEP to recommend a stack for my task. Inspect existing tools, search catalogs, compare named candidates and explain setup requirements.
